label: 인스타그램
prompt_hint: Create an Instagram-ready promotional image optimized for modern Korean social media aesthetics. Use the uploaded product image as the only hero subject while preserving realistic appearance, balanced composition, clean spacing, and refined SNS visual quality. Maintain natural environmental styling without changing the original product identity.
channel_prompt: Use the uploaded product image as the ONLY main subject. Create a Korean Instagram-style promotional image layout. This prompt defines composition rules, image behavior, visual hierarchy, and layout constraints. Maintain a single-product composition and preserve the uploaded product identity, shape, color, texture, and realistic appearance. Do not generate additional products. Build a clean layered composition using subtle environmental depth, soft background separation, and natural scene continuity while keeping the uploaded product visually clear and dominant. Maintain balanced spacing around the full product composition and clear single-product visual hierarchy. If the uploaded product is placed on a coaster, tray, plate, napkin, or supporting surface, preserve the original object relationship and keep the product naturally centered on that support object. Treat the product and its support as a single anchored composition unit. For beverage products, do not modify the internal drink composition, including ice, pearls, toppings, liquid amount, liquid level, ingredient ratio, or visible contents. For beverage products, remove straws from the final generated image even if they exist in the uploaded image, unless explicitly requested by the user. Preserve the actual drink identity, liquid contents, existing stirrers, decorative picks, inserted accessories, and overall beverage presentation without modifying the drink itself. Allow only subtle controlled visual enhancement such as slightly warmer or cleaner color temperature, mild saturation improvement, and moderate brightness and contrast refinement. Realistic cup surface gloss, condensation, and water droplets may be added only on the cup exterior or nearby surface, without changing the drink itself. Add beverage-type atmospheric effects only when naturally appropriate and only as external or surface-level styling. For food products, do not add ingredients, increase portion size, modify shape, regenerate toppings, or alter the food structure. Do not remove, hide, or omit existing toppings or garnishes. Allow only subtle color temperature refinement, surface gloss enhancement, background contrast adjustment, and minimal non-distracting surrounding prop styling. When no text or marketing copy is requested, place the product or anchored composition unit at the visual center of the canvas. When headline, product name, or marketing copy is requested, allow the product or anchored composition unit to shift naturally within the selected layout so that the product and text form a balanced advertising composition. Even when the product position changes for text composition, preserve the original product-support relationship and keep the product centered relative to its coaster, tray, plate, napkin, or supporting surface. Avoid unintended lateral drift, edge touching, floating appearance, detached support alignment, or support-product mismatch. Keep the entire product or anchored composition unit fully visible and prevent unnatural zoom-in, object cropping, isolated cutout appearance, and oversized rendering. Preserve balanced surrounding negative space and maintain stable composition across different aspect ratios. For all Instagram formats, keep the product or anchored composition unit around 50-55% of canvas height. Do not reduce product scale only because the layout is vertical. Maintain balanced safe margins while keeping the product visually dominant. Reserve visually appropriate empty space for future text composition when needed. If headline, product name, or marketing copy is requested, generate clean and readable Korean typography naturally integrated into the composition while preserving visual balance and product visibility. Apply intentional commercial lighting with a focused key light on the product to create an aspirational advertising mood without excessive studio effects. Use soft background separation with gradual depth transition to visually isolate the product and enhance its prominence without altering the original scene structure. Use realistic lighting, realistic colors, clean composition, minimal editing, modern Korean SNS visual aesthetic, and natural atmosphere. Do not generate people, hands, faces, characters, watermarks, UI elements, pricing UI, numeric offer labels, discount badge graphics, promotional offer visuals, storefront pricing boards, excessive props, cluttered backgrounds, distracting objects, random letters, or unrelated visual elements. Generate only the final composed promotional image.
